metadata.title: GRUT-RAI: Frozen Research Record, Books Working Edition (I–X), and RAI Audit Infrastructure — Release zenodo-v1.0
metadata.description: First public release of the GRUT research program in its present, frozen state: (1) the frozen technical record — model framework, program freeze and stopping rule, the Γ_T prediction gate and its computed closure, the signature audit, and the 74-node claims register; (2) the GRUT Books Working Edition — a ten-book corpus presenting the constitutive-relational framework with every substantive claim labeled by epistemic status inline (DERIVED / RECOVERED / ASSUMPTION / HYPOTHESIS / UNRESOLVED / CLOSED / UNMAPPED / REVERSED), governed by a corpus charter and canonical status table; the PREDICTED set is empty and the corpus says so; (3) the RAI audit infrastructure — five adversarial multi-agent instrument records with executable verification gates. This is a working edition and a publishing pass over the frozen record: no scientific substance was altered in preparation. Markdown files are the authoritative sources; PDFs are generated from them. See README.md for the reading order and MANIFEST.md for per-file SHA-256 integrity.
